feature: Crypto Landing Page — conversion-focused marketing page for a crypto product (exchange/wallet/portfolio). Goals: communicate trust, explain value, drive sign-ups (primary CTA), and showcase product features & real-time price snapshot.
screens: Hero (Email/Wallet CTA) — large headline, subhead, primary CTA + secondary CTA, live price ticker strip, hero illustration/device mockup, social proof logos
How it Works — 3-step horizontal cards with icons and CTAs
Features & Benefits — alternating feature blocks with interactive micro-demo (small chart + toggles)
Security & Trust — credentials, audits, SOC logos, two-factor flow diagram, insurance coverage callout
Pricing / Plans (if applicable) — 3 column comparison with feature checklist and CTA per plan
Live Market Snapshot — responsive table of top 10 cryptos, sparkline, 24h % change, filter & search
FAQ & Risk Notice — accordion list with prominent compliance/legal note
Footer + Secondary Sign-up — links, newsletter, social, legal, language selector
components: Header: logo (left), nav (center: Products, Markets, Learn, Pricing), Sign In (text) and Primary CTA (Sign Up) on right. Sticky with subtle shadow on scroll.
Hero CTA: Primary (Solid, filled) 56x44px min, Secondary (Outline). Both accessible labels and keyboard focus.
Live Price Ticker: horizontal marquee style with pause on hover, semantic list with aria-live="polite" for updates.
Feature Cards: icon (SVG), title, 2–3 line description, small CTA. Cards use 16px body, 20px title, 24px icon, 24px padding.
Interactive Micro-demo: small responsive chart (canvas/SVG), toggle state (USD/BTC), play/pause micro-anim.
Market Table Row: left: rank+symbol with favicon, middle: price + sparkline (svg, aria-hidden), right: 24h change (color-coded) and action button (Add to Watchlist). Rows keyboard-focusable.
Accordion (FAQ): grouped region with aria-controls, aria-expanded, keyboard support (Enter/Space).
Trust Badges: accessible images with alt text and tooltip for details.
Newsletter Modal: email input with visible label, validation, success state, recaptcha placeholder.
Back-to-top floating button: 56px circular, high-contrast, respects prefers-reduced-motion.
interactions: Hero CTA click -> open Sign-up modal or route to sign-up page; focus moves into first input; ESC closes (return focus to CTA).
Price ticker updates via WebSocket/Server-Sent Events; new items announce via aria-live. Pause on hover and on reduced-motion.
Market table sorting: click header toggles asc/desc; keyboard users can sort via enter on header button.
Feature cards reveal micro-animations on scroll (fade+translate Y 20px, 240ms, ease-out). Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling translation.
Interactive chart toggles datapoints; hovering shows tooltip with formatted values; for touch, tap opens tooltip as persistent overlay.
Accordion: only one open at a time (optional), arrow rotates 180deg; animation 160ms; disable animations for prefers-reduced-motion.
Newsletter modal input shows inline validation (email format), server errors shown in error summary above field.
Responsive nav: mobile hamburger opens full-screen sheet with large tap targets (>=44px).
states: Loading: skeletons for hero mockup, market table rows, and feature cards. Use gray-100 boxes and shimmer only if not reduced-motion.
Empty: market table shows inline empty state with CTA to add markets or refresh.
Error: global banner for data fetch errors with retry button; form fields show red outline + helper text; both accessible via aria-live="assertive".
Success: newsletter signup shows inline success message and CTA to continue, modal closes after confirmation (animated).
Disabled: CTA disabled state when input invalid (opacity 0.6, cursor not-allowed) with aria-disabled="true".
responsive: Mobile-first. Breakpoints: base (≤640px), tablet (641–1024px), desktop (≥1025px). Layout rules: single-column stacking on mobile; hero image hidden/stacked under headline; market table compresses to list cards with essential columns; feature grid: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop. Nav collapses to hamburger under 768px. All touch targets >=44px; 16px base font-size, scale up 18–20px for desktop titles.
design_system: Proposed tokens (if no existing DS): palette — primary: #0B63FF (CTA), accent: #7A5CFF, neutral-900: #0B1220, neutral-100: #F6F7FB, success: #00B37E, danger: #FF4D4F. Typography — Inter (variable) for UI: H1 40/48 (desktop) / 28/36 (mobile), H2 28/36, Body 16/24. Spacing scale: 4,8,16,24,32,48,64. Elevation: subtle shadows for sticky header and cards. Accessibility: contrast ratios >=4.5:1 for body text; focus ring 3px offset using primary-500; provide semantic HTML + ARIA. Motion: durations 120–320ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1).
api_needs: Public market feed (WebSocket or SSE) endpoint streaming price, 24h change, market cap, sparkline data for top N assets.
Trust metadata endpoint: audit reports, insurance coverage, certification logos.
Newsletter subscription API (POST) with 200/4xx/5xx responses; rate-limit headers and error codes.
Sign-up endpoint (POST) and validation endpoints (email uniqueness).
Feature demo data endpoints (sample portfolio / simulated trades) for micro-demo.
acceptance_criteria: Header & hero render correctly across breakpoints and hero CTA opens sign-up modal with focus management.
Live price ticker updates within 2s of server push and announces changes to screen readers.
Market table supports sorting and keyboard navigation; sparkline present and rows are focusable.
Forms validate inline and show accessible error messages; newsletter submission shows success state.
All interactive animations respect prefers-reduced-motion and keyboard users can operate all controls.
Contrast ratios for text meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body) and focus indicators visible. Automated responsive QA shows no horizontal scroll at any breakpoint.
